description: This file implements a helper class for managing front panel indicators, including brightness, blinking patterns, and power states, within a larger embedded or set-top box software system. It includes methods for controlling LEDs, handling blinking sequences, and interfacing with hardware indicators and text displays.

classes.name: CFrontPanel
classes.description: Main class managing front panel indicators, including brightness, blinking patterns, and power states, with methods to control LEDs and handle blinking sequences.

classes.name: BlinkInfo
classes.description: Helper class representing blinking pattern information, including color, brightness, duration, and methods for timing.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for CFrontPanel, initializes hardware interfaces and configurations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the front panel indicator control, initializing indicators and power state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops blinking timers and disables indicators.

methods.name: setPowerStatus
methods.description: Sets the current power status of the device.

methods.name: getLastError
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: addEventObserver
methods.description: Adds an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: removeEventObserver
methods.description: Removes an observer for front panel events.

methods.name: setBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness level of the front panel indicators.

methods.name: getBrightness
methods.description: Retrieves the current brightness level.

methods.name: setClockBrightness
methods.description: Sets the brightness of the clock display, if enabled.

methods.name: getClockBrightness
methods.description: Gets the current clock display brightness.

methods.name: powerOnLed
methods.description: Turns on specified front panel indicator LEDs.

methods.name: powerOffLed
methods.description: Turns off specified front panel indicator LEDs.

methods.name: powerOffAllLed
methods.description: Turns off all front panel LEDs.

methods.name: powerOnAllLed
methods.description: Turns on all front panel LEDs.

methods.name: setLED
methods.description: Configures a specific LED's color and brightness based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: setBlink
methods.description: Configures blinking pattern for a front panel indicator based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: getPreferences
methods.description: Retrieves current front panel preferences.

methods.name: setPreferences
methods.description: Saves front panel preferences to persistent storage.

methods.name: loadPreferences
methods.description: Loads preferences from persistent storage.

methods.name: startBlinkTimer
methods.description: Starts blinking timer with specified repeat count.

methods.name: stopBlinkTimer
methods.description: Stops blinking timer.

methods.name: setBlinkLed
methods.description: Sets the LED to a specific blinking pattern.

methods.name: onBlinkTimer
methods.description: Callback invoked on blinking timer expiration to handle blinking sequence.

methods.name: set24HourClock
methods.description: Configures the clock display to 24-hour or 12-hour format.

methods.name: is24HourClock
methods.description: Checks if the clock display is in 24-hour format.
